blockrooms.configuration.title: The Blockrooms Configs
blockrooms.configuration.ruby_trans_time: The time required for emerald transform to blockrooms ruby (tick)
blockrooms.configuration.level_info_enab: Show the level info panel (typewriter effect) at the bottom-right when entering a level. Content comes from the lang-style JSON files in assets/blockrooms/level_info/ (e.g. en_us.json, zh_cn.json), selected by client language with en_us as fallback; override them with a resource pack.
blockrooms.configuration.level_difficult: Show the survival difficulty panel (title + safe / security / entity) permanently at the top-right while inside a level. Content comes from the same level_info JSON files.
blockrooms.configuration.level_info_type: Ticks between each character of the typewriter effect (1-20).
blockrooms.configuration.level_info_hold: Ticks the text stays visible after the last line (0-600).
blockrooms.configuration.level_info_pane: Maximum width of the level info panel in GUI pixels (100-400); the panel shrinks to fit its content and only reaches this size when needed.
Maximum rows visible in the level info panel (2-12); shorter content fits dynamically, longer content gets a scrollbar and can be scrolled with the mouse wheel.
